```{r}
##Let's visualize max ΔG for multiplex
##Pairwise in silico heterodimer prediction performed with IDT's the OligoAnalyzer tool: https://www.idtdna.com/pages/tools/oligoanalyzer

library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# Primer name mapping
name_map <- c(
  "ACAGGTGCTAATACCGCATAAT" = "CecorumF",
  "CCCACCAACTAGCTAATGCAC" = "CecorumR",
  "ACCGCATGGTAGATGGATGAAAGGC" = "CecorumP",
  "GACCGTTGCTGCGACAGTTA" = "HiraeF",
  "GAGCCTGCGACGTTCAACAT" = "HiraeR",
  "TGGCTTAGGGTTTGGACACACGAT" = "HiraeP"
)

# Pairwise data
df <- data.frame(
  Sequence1 = c("ACAGGTGCTAATACCGCATAAT","ACAGGTGCTAATACCGCATAAT","ACAGGTGCTAATACCGCATAAT",
                 "ACAGGTGCTAATACCGCATAAT","ACAGGTGCTAATACCGCATAAT","CCCACCAACTAGCTAATGCAC",
                 "CCCACCAACTAGCTAATGCAC","CCCACCAACTAGCTAATGCAC","CCCACCAACTAGCTAATGCAC",
                 "ACCGCATGGTAGATGGATGAAAGGC","ACCGCATGGTAGATGGATGAAAGGC","ACCGCATGGTAGATGGATGAAAGGC",
                 "GACCGTTGCTGCGACAGTTA","GACCGTTGCTGCGACAGTTA","GAGCCTGCGACGTTCAACAT"),
  Sequence2 = c("CCCACCAACTAGCTAATGCAC","ACCGCATGGTAGATGGATGAAAGGC","GACCGTTGCTGCGACAGTTA",
                 "GAGCCTGCGACGTTCAACAT","TGGCTTAGGGTTTGGACACACGAT","ACCGCATGGTAGATGGATGAAAGGC",
                 "GACCGTTGCTGCGACAGTTA","GAGCCTGCGACGTTCAACAT","TGGCTTAGGGTTTGGACACACGAT",
                 "GACCGTTGCTGCGACAGTTA","GAGCCTGCGACGTTCAACAT","TGGCTTAGGGTTTGGACACACGAT",
                 "GAGCCTGCGACGTTCAACAT","TGGCTTAGGGTTTGGACACACGAT","TGGCTTAGGGTTTGGACACACGAT"),
  DeltaG = c(-6.57, -5.37, -8.70, -8.70, -4.50, -6.57,
             -5.24, -5.09, -6.97, -8.70, -8.70, -4.41,
             -5.24, -4.95, -4.95)
)

# Replace sequences with primer names
df$Primer1 <- name_map[df$Sequence1]
df$Primer2 <- name_map[df$Sequence2]

# Define primer order
primer_order <- c("CecorumF", "CecorumR", "CecorumP", "HiraeF", "HiraeR", "HiraeP")

# Build symmetric matrix for heatmap
mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = 6, ncol = 6, dimnames = list(primer_order, primer_order))

for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
  mat[df$Primer1[i], df$Primer2[i]] <- df$DeltaG[i]
  mat[df$Primer2[i], df$Primer1[i]] <- df$DeltaG[i]
}

# Melt for ggplot
melted <- melt(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(melted) <- c("Primer1", "Primer2", "DeltaG")
melted$Primer1 <- factor(melted$Primer1, levels = primer_order)
melted$Primer2 <- factor(melted$Primer2, levels = primer_order)

# Keep only lower triangle
melted_lower <- melted[as.numeric(melted$Primer1) > as.numeric(melted$Primer2), ]

melted_lower <- droplevels(melted_lower)

ggplot(melted_lower, aes(x = Primer2, y = Primer1, fill = DeltaG)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(DeltaG, 2)), size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d3436e", high = "white",
                      name = expression(Delta*G~"(kcal/mol)"),
                      guide = guide_colorbar(frame.colour = "black",
                                             ticks.colour = "black")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Heterodimer ΔG Between All Multiplex Primer/Probe Pairs",
       x = "", y = "") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )


```

```{r}
# Melt for ggplot
melted <- reshape2::melt(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(melted) <- c("Primer1", "Primer2", "DeltaG")

# Use primer_order for indexing (robust)
melted$i <- match(melted$Primer1, primer_order)
melted$j <- match(melted$Primer2, primer_order)

# Keep only lower triangle (i > j)
melted_lower <- subset(melted, i > j)

# Set factor levels:
# x stays in normal order, y is reversed so the triangle sits at the bottom
melted_lower$Primer2 <- factor(melted_lower$Primer2, levels = primer_order)
melted_lower$Primer1 <- factor(melted_lower$Primer1, levels = rev(primer_order))

ggplot(melted_lower, aes(x = Primer2, y = Primer1, fill = DeltaG)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(DeltaG, 2)), size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d3436e", high = "white",
                      name = expression(Delta*G~"(kcal/mol)"),
                      guide = guide_colorbar(frame.colour = "black",
                                             ticks.colour = "black")) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = TRUE, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Heterodimer ΔG Between All Multiplex Primer/Probe Pairs",
       x = "", y = "") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title  = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

ggsave("heteroduplex.corr.png", width = 6.5, height = 4.5, units = "in", dpi = 900)
```

```{r}
##Genus-level analysis
entero.genus.dpcr <- read.csv("~/Documents/DeQueen_Litter/entero.genus.dpcr.csv")
entero.qubit.clean <- read.csv("~/Documents/DeQueen_Litter/entero.qubit.clean.csv")
```


```{r}
##Add metadata to genus-level dPCR results and filter to biological samples
entero.filtered <- entero.genus.dpcr %>%
  filter(Sample.NTC.Control %in% as.character(1:60)) %>%
  mutate(sample_key = paste0("Sample_", Sample.NTC.Control)) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = c("sample_key" = "Sample.ID")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-sample_key)

##Now, for every sample, take the mean of technical duplicates and filter out unnecessary data
entero.summary <- entero.filtered %>%
  mutate(
    `Conc...cp.µL...dPCR.reaction.`      = as.numeric(`Conc...cp.µL...dPCR.reaction.`),
    `Conc...cp.µL...undiluted.sample.`   = as.numeric(`Conc...cp.µL...undiluted.sample.`)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample.NTC.Control) %>%
  summarise(
    Conc.dpcr      = mean(`Conc...cp.µL...dPCR.reaction.`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Conc.undiluted = mean(`Conc...cp.µL...undiluted.sample.`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Growout        = first(Growout),
    Position       = first(Position),
    Treatment      = first(Treatment),
    House          = first(House),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
##Let's add in qubit concentrations (after cleanup) to get total enterococcus load/sample
entero.merged <- entero.summary %>%
  inner_join(
    entero.qubit.clean %>% dplyr::select(Sample, X260.230, X260.280, ng.uL..nanodrop., ng.uL..qubit.),
    by = c("Sample.NTC.Control" = "Sample")
  )

##Back calculate to get per gram of litter. 
elution_vol <- 100 

entero.merged <- entero.merged %>%
  mutate(
    copies_per_reaction = Conc.dpcr * 15,
    copies_per_ng       = copies_per_reaction / 4,
    total_ng_extracted  = ng.uL..qubit. * elution_vol,
    copies_per_gram     = copies_per_ng * total_ng_extracted / 0.25
  )

```

```{r}
# Distribution screening for copies_per_gram
# Distribution screening: raw + log10 copies_per_gram

library(MASS)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

entero.merged <- entero.merged %>%
  mutate(
    log10_copies_per_gram = log10(copies_per_gram)
  )

for (g in c("1", "2")) {

  df_sub <- entero.merged %>%
    filter(Growout == g)

  vars <- c("copies_per_gram", "log10_copies_per_gram")

  cat("\n============================\n")
  cat(paste("Growout:", g, "\n"))

  for (v in vars) {

    y <- df_sub[[v]]
    y <- y[!is.na(y) & is.finite(y)]

    cat("\n----------------------------\n")
    cat(paste("Variable:", v, "\n"))

    shapiro_result <- shapiro.test(y)
    cat("Shapiro-Wilk p-value:", round(shapiro_result$p.value, 4), "\n")

    print(
      ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = .data[[v]])) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
        ggtitle(paste(v, "- Growout", g))
    )

    dist_fits <- list()

    try(dist_fits$normal  <- MASS::fitdistr(y, "normal"), silent = TRUE)
    try(dist_fits$gamma   <- MASS::fitdistr(y[y > 0], "gamma"), silent = TRUE)
    try(dist_fits$lognorm <- MASS::fitdistr(y[y > 0], "lognormal"), silent = TRUE)

    aics <- sapply(dist_fits, AIC)
    cat("AICs:\n")
    print(round(aics, 2))
    cat("Best distribution (AIC):", names(which.min(aics)), "\n")
  }
}

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Genus-level Enterococcus GLMM — Raw counts with lognormal distribution
# Log-transform response + Gaussian family (based on distribution screening)
# ==============================================================

library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(dplyr)

# ==============================================================
# Setup data with log transformation of raw counts
# ==============================================================

entero_df_genus_raw <- entero.merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Growout   = as.factor(Growout),
    Treatment = as.factor(Treatment),
    House     = as.factor(House),
    Position  = as.factor(Position),
    log_copies_raw = log(copies_per_gram)  # Natural log for lognormal
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(log_copies_raw))

cat("Genus-level samples:", nrow(entero_df_genus_raw), "\n")

# Set contrasts for Type III tests
old_contr_genus <- options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

# ==============================================================
# Fit full model with random effect (lognormal = log-transform + gaussian)
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_model_raw <- glmmTMB(
  log_copies_raw ~ Treatment * Growout + Position + (1 | Growout:House),
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  data   = entero_df_genus_raw
)

# ==============================================================
# Check and conditionally drop random effect
# ==============================================================

kept_random_genus <- TRUE
rv_genus <- .extract_rand_var(entero_genus_model_raw)
cat("Random effect variance (Growout:House):", rv_genus, "\n")

if (is.na(rv_genus) || rv_genus <= 1e-6) {
  kept_random_genus <- FALSE
  cat("Random effect near zero — refitting without it.\n")
  
  entero_genus_model_raw <- glmmTMB(
    log_copies_raw ~ Treatment * Growout + Position,
    family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
    data   = entero_df_genus_raw
  )
} else {
  cat("Random effect retained\n")
}

# ==============================================================
# Type III Wald tests
# ==============================================================

cat("\n--- Type III Wald Tests ---\n")
entero_genus_anova_raw <- car::Anova(entero_genus_model_raw, type = 3)
print(entero_genus_anova_raw)

# ==============================================================
# Global treatment effect (marginal means)
# ==============================================================

cat("\n--- Global Treatment Effect ---\n")
entero_genus_global_emm_raw <- emmeans(entero_genus_model_raw, ~ Treatment)
entero_genus_global_pairs_raw <- contrast(entero_genus_global_emm_raw, 
                                          method = "pairwise", 
                                          adjust = "BH")
global_genus_df_raw <- as.data.frame(summary(entero_genus_global_pairs_raw))
global_genus_df_raw$Comparison <- "Global"
global_genus_df_raw$Growout <- NA
print(summary(entero_genus_global_pairs_raw))

# ==============================================================
# Per-growout treatment effects
# ==============================================================

cat("\n--- Per-Growout Treatment Effects ---\n")
entero_genus_pergrowout_emm_raw <- emmeans(entero_genus_model_raw, ~ Treatment | Growout)
entero_genus_pergrowout_pairs_raw <- contrast(entero_genus_pergrowout_emm_raw, 
                                              method = "pairwise", 
                                              adjust = "BH")
pergrowout_genus_df_raw <- as.data.frame(summary(entero_genus_pergrowout_pairs_raw))
pergrowout_genus_df_raw$Comparison <- paste("Growout", pergrowout_genus_df_raw$Growout)
print(summary(entero_genus_pergrowout_pairs_raw))

# ==============================================================
# DHARMa diagnostics
# ==============================================================

cat("\n--- DHARMa Diagnostics ---\n")
entero_genus_dharma_raw <- simulateResiduals(entero_genus_model_raw, n = 1000)

disp_test_genus_raw <- testDispersion(entero_genus_dharma_raw)
out_test_genus_raw <- testOutliers(entero_genus_dharma_raw)
quant_test_genus_raw <- testQuantiles(entero_genus_dharma_raw)

cat("Dispersion p =", round(disp_test_genus_raw$p.value, 4), "\n")
cat("Outliers p =", round(out_test_genus_raw$p.value, 4), "\n")
cat("Quantiles p =", round(quant_test_genus_raw$p.value, 4), "\n")

# ==============================================================
# Combine results
# ==============================================================

common_cols_genus_raw <- intersect(names(global_genus_df_raw), names(pergrowout_genus_df_raw))
entero_genus_pairs_all_raw <- rbind(
  global_genus_df_raw[, common_cols_genus_raw],
  pergrowout_genus_df_raw[, common_cols_genus_raw]
)

# Restore contrasts
options(old_contr_genus)

# ==============================================================
# Summary of genus results
# ==============================================================

cat("\n==============================================\n")
cat("GENUS-LEVEL ENTEROCOCCUS RAW COUNT RESULTS SUMMARY\n")
cat("==============================================\n")

treatment_main_genus_raw <- entero_genus_anova_raw["Treatment", ]
cat("Main Treatment Effect: Chi² =", round(treatment_main_genus_raw$Chisq, 2),
    ", p =", round(treatment_main_genus_raw$`Pr(>Chisq)`, 4),
    ifelse(treatment_main_genus_raw$`Pr(>Chisq)` < 0.05, " *", ""), "\n")

sig_genus_raw <- entero_genus_pairs_all_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(p.value < 0.05)

if (nrow(sig_genus_raw) > 0) {
  cat("\nSignificant contrasts:\n")
  print(sig_genus_raw %>% dplyr::select(Comparison, estimate, SE, z.ratio, p.value))
} else {
  cat("\nNo significant treatment contrasts at p < 0.05\n")
}

cat("\nModel kept random effect:", kept_random_genus, "\n")

```

```{r}
##Pull out all relevant p-values for the manuscript
# ==============================================================
# Genus-level Enterococcus GLMM p-values:
#   1. Global fixed effects across growouts
#   2. Fixed effects within each growout
#   3. Optional treatment pairwise contrasts via emmeans
# ==============================================================

library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

# --------------------------------------------------------------
# Preserve Type III contrast settings
# --------------------------------------------------------------

old_contr_genus_pvals <- options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

# ==============================================================
# 1. Global fixed-effect p-values from full model
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_global_fixed_pvals <- car::Anova(
  entero_genus_model_raw,
  type = 3
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Fixed_Effect") %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Chi_square = Chisq,
    df = Df,
    p_value = `Pr(>Chisq)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Model = "Global",
    Growout = NA_character_,
    kept_random = kept_random_genus
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Model,
    Growout,
    Fixed_Effect,
    Chi_square,
    df,
    p_value,
    kept_random
  )

print(entero_genus_global_fixed_pvals)

# ==============================================================
# 2. Fixed-effect p-values within each growout
#    Model within growout: Treatment + Position + (1 | House)
#    Random effect dropped if near-zero variance
# ==============================================================

.extract_house_rand_var <- function(model) {
  vc <- try(glmmTMB::VarCorr(model), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(vc, "try-error")) return(NA_real_)

  vcdf <- try(as.data.frame(vc), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(vcdf, "try-error") || !nrow(vcdf)) return(NA_real_)

  row <- vcdf[
    vcdf$component == "cond" &
      vcdf$grp == "House",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (!nrow(row)) return(NA_real_)

  as.numeric(row$sdcor[1])^2
}

entero_genus_within_growout_fixed_pvals <- purrr::map_dfr(
  levels(entero_df_genus_raw$Growout),
  function(growout_i) {

    df_i <- entero_df_genus_raw %>%
      dplyr::filter(Growout == growout_i) %>%
      base::droplevels()

    model_i <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
      log_copies_raw ~ Treatment + Position + (1 | House),
      family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
      data = df_i
    )

    rv_i <- .extract_house_rand_var(model_i)
    kept_random_i <- TRUE

    if (is.na(rv_i) || rv_i <= 1e-6) {
      kept_random_i <- FALSE

      model_i <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
        log_copies_raw ~ Treatment + Position,
        family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
        data = df_i
      )
    }

    car::Anova(model_i, type = 3) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("Fixed_Effect") %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        Chi_square = Chisq,
        df = Df,
        p_value = `Pr(>Chisq)`
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Model = "Within growout",
        Growout = as.character(growout_i),
        kept_random = kept_random_i
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Model,
        Growout,
        Fixed_Effect,
        Chi_square,
        df,
        p_value,
        kept_random
      )
  }
)

print(entero_genus_within_growout_fixed_pvals)

# ==============================================================
# 3. Treatment pairwise contrasts using emmeans
#    These are pairwise treatment comparisons, not omnibus effects
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_global_treatment_pairs <- emmeans::emmeans(
  entero_genus_model_raw,
  ~ Treatment
) %>%
  emmeans::contrast(
    method = "pairwise",
    adjust = "BH"
  ) %>%
  summary() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Model = "Global",
    Growout = NA_character_
  )

entero_genus_within_growout_treatment_pairs <- emmeans::emmeans(
  entero_genus_model_raw,
  ~ Treatment | Growout
) %>%
  emmeans::contrast(
    method = "pairwise",
    adjust = "BH"
  ) %>%
  summary() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Model = "Within growout"
  )

print(entero_genus_global_treatment_pairs)
print(entero_genus_within_growout_treatment_pairs)

# ==============================================================
# 4. Combined fixed-effect p-value table
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_fixed_pvals_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  entero_genus_global_fixed_pvals,
  entero_genus_within_growout_fixed_pvals
)

print(entero_genus_fixed_pvals_all)

# Restore contrast settings
options(old_contr_genus_pvals)

```

```{r}
##Let's look at the correlation between microbiome and dPCR counts. 
# ---- Extract Enterococcus genus abundance (per-sample) ----

entero_genus_df <- phy_genus %>%
  subset_taxa(Genus == "Enterococcus") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Abundance, Growout, Treatment, House, Position) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Enterococcus_abundance = Abundance)

```

```{r}
# ---- Merge + correlation + plot ----

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

entero_combined <- entero_genus_df %>%
  mutate(
    Sample.NTC.Control = gsub("Sample_", "", Sample)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(entero.merged, by = "Sample.NTC.Control")

# ---- Correlation (Spearman, recompute p-value to avoid underflow) ----
cor_res <- cor.test(
  entero_combined$Enterococcus_abundance,
  entero_combined$log10_copies_per_gram,
  method = "spearman"
)

rho <- cor_res$estimate
n   <- sum(complete.cases(entero_combined$Enterococcus_abundance,
                          entero_combined$log10_copies_per_gram))

# Approximate t-statistic for Spearman
t_stat <- as.numeric(rho) * sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - rho^2))

# Recalculate p-value (two-sided)
p_val <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat), df = n - 2)

# ---- Plot ----
ggplot(entero_combined, aes(x = Enterococcus_abundance, y = log10_copies_per_gram)) +
  geom_point(
    shape = 21,
    fill = "royalblue4",
    color = "black",
    size = 4,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    label = paste0(
      "rho == ", round(rho, 2),
      "*','~~italic(p) == ", formatC(p_val, format = "e", digits = 2)
    ),
    parse = TRUE,
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 3,
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "CSS-normalized counts (V1-V9 ONT)",
    y = expression(Log[10]~"copies per gram (dPCR)")) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color = 'black'))

ggsave("genus.entero.correlation.png", width = 5, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 900)

```
